advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.weightHint: Several models can share a public name; requests are spread by weight. Leave it empty on all of them for an even share; once any has a weight, those without one (or with 0) only take traffic when the others are down.

router.num_retriesHint: How many more times a failed request is tried, on another deployment when there is one.
router.allowed_failsHint: Failures a minute before a deployment sits out. A 429 makes it sit out at once.
router.cooldown_timeHint: How long a failing deployment sits out.
router.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number in range
router.fallbacksHint: When a model still fails after its retries, these models are tried, in order.
router.context_window_fallbacksHint: When the prompt does not fit, these take over. Without a rule here, the fallbacks above apply.
router.content_policy_fallbacksHint: When the provider refuses the content, these take over. Without a rule here, the fallbacks above apply.
